In an undirected graph, the nodes are numbered from 0 to 14, and every node has an embedding. (i,j) means that node i and node j are connected with an undirected edge.
Embeddings:
node 0: [0,0]
node 1: [0,1]
node 2: [1,0]
node 3: [0,1]
node 4: [0,0]
node 5: [1,1]
node 6: [1,0]
node 7: [0,1]
node 8: [0,0]
node 9: [1,0]
node 10: [0,0]
node 11: [1,0]
node 12: [1,0]
node 13: [1,0]
node 14: [0,1]
The edges are: (0,3) (0,5) (0,4) (0,14) (1,2) (1,7) (1,14) (1,11) (2,14) (3,4) (3,14) (4,8) (4,12) (4,7) (5,8) (6,13) (6,12) (6,10) (7,9) (8,10) (9,10)
In a simple graph convolution layer, each node's embedding is updated by the sum of its neighbors' embeddings.
Q: What's the embedding of each node after one layer of simple graph convolution layer?
A:

Return only a JSON object using this schema: {"node_embeddings":{"0":[0,0]}}
